Interface IShapeTypeProvider

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Geometry
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Exposes the canonical ShapeType for a concrete shape type. Implementers should return the ShapeType that represents the concrete shape instance. Consumers (for example ShapeHandle<T>) can use this to perform fast, allocation-free type checks and mappings.
